+

The new ELF is explicitly selected at /work/guide-engine/openroad; original runtime/image/resource policies remain enforced. The admission checker uses the actual captured qualification and22 faults, including changed net/clock/geometry/DRC/antenna records, wrong ELF/runtime, missing phases, failed commands and OOM.

Native helper bodies, router arguments, snapshots and process cleanup remain identical. This starts a fresh route from the authenticated original seed; it does not claim to resume hidden internal router state.
+
+Route execution retains the existing14400second supervisor bound inside the360minute hosted workflow and11GiB RSS limit inside12GiB cgroup. The bounded-worker engine is the intended memory change; no memory saving or convergence is claimed before actual results. Every returned or failed native checkpoint and full supervision stream must remain in the permanent cloud capsule. Run source controls independently at the exact source before native dispatch and reserve that run's release externally.
+
+Full serial PHY, DRC/antenna closure, final setup/hold, LVS and production acceptance require their own actual evidence. A completed experiment with nonzero violations is not signoff.
+
+The source-only experiment commit skips duplicate automatic push CI on its frozen historical RTL parent. Independently dispatched source controls include all prior suites plus actual-capture admission mutations; the native route is separately dispatched at that exact tested source.
